intent: Implement this as a standard staged change: increase internet slice AMBR from 20 to 60 Mbps in stages with mandatory KPI validation between stages. After each stage, check ambr_dl_mean via kpi_analyzer. Advance to the next stage only after KPI confirms the previous one. At least 3 stages. Use feasibility_checker and policy_manager apply. AMBR in bps. The target_slice parameter is 'internet'.
